title: FactorIA AI config (~/.factoria/ai.json)
description: User-level AI configuration: providers (API keys or CLI agents) and the roles orchestrator/worker/fast. Lives in the user's home, NEVER inside a game project.

defaultProvider.description: Provider used by roles that do not set one. Default: anthropic.

providers.description: Providers by name. Built-in names (anthropic, openai, openrouter, gemini, groq, deepseek, ollama, lmstudio, claude-code, codex) exist without being listed; listing one overrides its fields.

roles.description: Which provider/model plays each role. orchestrator plans and delegates, worker implements, fast does small mechanical tasks.

limits.description: Safety limits for one agent run.

provider.description: Name of an entry in providers (or a built-in).

preset.description: openai-compatible only: fills baseUrl and apiKeyEnv.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the key.

apiKey.description: The key itself. Prefer apiKeyEnv. Only honoured in this user-level file.

useAntCli.description: anthropic: fall back to `ant auth print-credentials` when no key is set.

sendReasoningEffort.description: openai-compatible: send reasoning_effort (low|medium|high) from the role effort.

command.description: CLI agents: executable name or path.

argv.description: CLI agents: argv template after the command. Placeholders: {prompt} {model} {project} {mcp_config} {session} {project_json} {factoria_json}. {session} is the CLI session id of the conversation (an argument whose placeholder is empty, like the first message's {session}, is dropped together with a bare flag before it). Without {prompt} the prompt is sent on standard input; with `--input-format stream-json` it is one JSON user message that can carry images.

factoriaCommand.description: Command that starts FactorIA for the MCP server. Default: factoria.

pricing.description: USD per 1M tokens, for cost estimates of non-Claude models.
